set system host-name DeviceA.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system login user rtb.explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

authentication plain-text-password \"@%@.explanation: Configure the system login user's authentication as an explicit password.

set system services aaa authentication-o.template: set system services aaa authentication-order [ parameter1 ]
set system services aaa authentication-o.command: set system services aaa authentication-order [ password ]

encapsulation ppp.explanation: Configure the type of envelope for the sub-interface.

set interfaces lmp-1/0/0 ppp-options cha.command: set interfaces lmp-1/0/0 ppp-options chap local-name rta
set interfaces lmp-1/0/0 ppp-options cha.explanation: 配置PPP CHAP认证的本地名称。

set interfaces lmp-1/0/0 ppp-options cha.command: set interfaces lmp-1/0/0 ppp-options chap default-challenge-response
set interfaces lmp-1/0/0 ppp-options cha.explanation: 启用PPP CHAP认证的默认挑战响应。

set access profile ppp-profile.explanation: This command fragment sets an access profile in Junos, defining a named profile (parameter1) to configure security policies, authentication, or authorization settings for network access.

parameters.name: profile-name
parameters.explanation: Accesses the name of the profile.

authentication-order password.explanation: Configures the authentication order for access to the profile.
